compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center (FSHC) (prior/Third Round); New Jersey Builders Association (NJBA) (Fourth Round obligation challenge)

notes: HEFSP adopted by Planning Board June 11, 2025; amended March 11, 2026; filed with court March 18, 2026 (BER-L-000477-25). DCA present need = 4 (accepted). DCA prospective need = 233; borough reduced to 121 (exempt parcels); NJBA challenged upward; settled by Program at 212. Borough adopted binding resolution January 21, 2025. Fourth Round RDP = 0: VLA confirmed no changed circumstances from prior round analysis; Borough lacks developable land. All 212 units = Unmet Need. FHA-2 requires 25% obligation (53 units) to be addressed by overlay zoning on likely-to-redevelop sites. Plan addresses this 53-unit threshold through Town Center Overlay (104 units proposed). Present need addressed via Bergen County Housing Rehabilitation Program (continuation from Third Round). Third Round RDP was 31; Borough satisfied nearly all through completed and proposed developments. Court order of March 6, 2018 established compliance. Town Center Overlay includes 18 parcels totaling 34.5 acres on Old Tappan Road. CORRECTION from DCA obligation (233 prospective need): the actual adopted obligation is 212 by Program settlement.

sites.site_name: Town Center Overlay Zone (TCO) - MU and PO Zones
sites.proposed_zoning: Town Center Overlay (MU-Mixed Use and PO-Professional Office sub-zones)
sites.quote: (a) MU Overlay Zone (21.9 acres): Block 1606, Lots 5 and 6; Block 1101, Lots 1,2,3,5; Block 1102, Lots 1-4 (b) PO Overlay Zone (12.6 acres): Block1605, Lots 4,5 and 6; Block 1606, Lot 8, Block 701, Lots 14.01,14.02 and 15; Block 701.01, Lot16
sites.notes: Town Center Overlay covers 18 parcels, 34.5 acres total. Intended density 15 du/acre. Gross potential: 104 affordable units (at 20% set-aside). Anticipated rental units; for-sale permitted subject to FHA minimums. MU Overlay (21.9 ac): promotes mixed use residential/commercial including Bi-State Plaza. PO Overlay (12.6 ac): professional office/residential. Overlay ordinance (Ordinance 129126) provides implementing zoning. This is the primary mechanism addressing the 25% redevelopment obligation (53 units) required for RDP=0 municipalities.
